evidence.title: EPA says power for data centers can sidestep pollution laws
Trump’s EPA wants to let data centers hide their air pollution

summary: The Trump administration’s Environmental Protection Agency announced a rule that would treat electricity used by data centers as an indirect emission, allowing the facilities to avoid compliance with certain air‑pollution standards. Environmental groups warn the move could increase greenhouse‑gas emissions and undermine existing clean‑air laws.
title: EPA proposes rule to let data centers sidestep clean‑air pollution regulations
